name: Fujieda Ryou
source:
[i]"Do you intend to stay here forever? In that case, I'm going back to my office."[/i]

A Takasato-gumi lawyer hired on retainer. Fujieda is a cold, clinical man who adopts a condescending attitude toward Towa.

[From the digital manual included with r59230]

[spoiler]His real name is Yuzuki Minato (柚木 湊)[/spoiler]
